comment: Formation recipes (docs/TERRAIN_SCENERY_PLAN.md T2, docs/LANDFORM_SURVEY.md). Each face takes the first recipe whose 'where' lists its setting: coast (the sea within coastMetres), otherwise its dominant relief (Plains, Hills, Tableland, Mountains). families weights the scans' material families; scale is the group's size range; gentleRockShare (at the face grade, 0.62) rising to rockShare (by grade 1.2) is the share of a face's ground meant to carry rock (walls always take rock; the rest stays soil and scree); typicalHeight and typicalWidth (metres, before scale) set the tiers' and columns' spacing; wetToe lets a sea cliff's toe stand in the surf. The recipe picks a scan's family by these weights; the family picks one of its scans by the scans' own weights.
